headline: Fishermans Row Erupts; Linn Mercy, DeadLands Go Quiet
war_summary: Latest despatches shift the focus to Fishermans Row, where two strategic-base actions have come in the past two hours and twenty-one in the day, with Dankana Post and Fort Ember the busiest points and casualties climbing on both sides. Linn Mercy, the previous night's storm centre, has not reported a fresh flip since 02:35, but remains a costly front with four actions in six hours and heavy recent losses. DeadLands likewise holds the bulletin: two actions in six hours, no new two-hour flip, and daily casualties above ten thousand on each side. Lykos Isle has cooled again after two six-hour actions and no recent event. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle, active earlier in the day, are silent on strategic bases, while Weathered Expanse continues to bleed heavily without a change in ownership. Clahstra remains punishing but static.
